## Summary

Describe the behavior changed and any unstable backend or SDK assumptions.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior with synthetic credentials and mocked network access.
- [ ] No live credentials, token files, or private account data are included.
- [ ] Public exports, README examples, and package metadata are updated where needed.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] No live example was run, or the authorized smoke test is explicitly documented.
